title: Method A Hole Benchmark Candidate E10 Production Fracture Simulation: HPC Cluster Staging, Datacheck Qualification, and Execution Readiness
scientific_objective: Prepare and qualify the HPC cluster execution package for the single production fracture simulation of Candidate E10 (PK_HOLE_SEL_E10_PROD.inp, 9,164 physical elements, 27,492 layered elements, 27,694 net independent physical DOFs) on the Mode-I off-axis-hole plate benchmark. Stage all dependencies to the remote cluster (/scratch9/pr21vyci/runs/mode1_method_a_hole_f1705_prod), verify frozen production UEL f42_mixed_uel.for (CE8D5EDCD2911DCB018BB15275271F874E7EA62B8FB48CF4A8297469A83ACDD6, 907 lines), integrate dual-channel notification wrappers (email + Telegram), configure PBS directives (Job M1_HOLE_SEL_E10_PROD, 1 CPU serial, 16 GB, 8h walltime, queue normal_imfdfkmq), execute a bounded cluster-side Abaqus datacheck on cluster login node (Exit Code 0), confirm zero duplicate jobs in scheduler accounting, and submit an evidence-backed execution-readiness handoff for independent review authorization before consuming the single planned PBS submission.
